verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes HVAC sizing calculations as a required permit-package deliverable while explicitly excluding Title 24 calculations.
The freelancer materially questions whether producing calculations is included rather than only reviewing and stamping.
The client specifies Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D as applicable calculation outputs for producing the drawings; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
The client resolves the scope conflict by assigning responsibility for the calculations, returning the clarified deliverable to active status.
